home.title: Study freely
home.description: Stop paying for flashcards and basic study tools. Create, practice, and master your materials — 100% free and barrier-free.

features.title: Everything you need for effective learning
features.description: No unnecessary features or distractions. Just the tools that help you remember.

spacedRepetition.title: Spaced Repetition
spacedRepetition.description: Mathematics at the service of memory. The server-side SuperMemo-2 algorithm calculates a difficulty factor for every word and reminds you just before you're about to forget it.

openSource.title: Absolute Freedom
openSource.description: The product belongs to the community, not corporations. No hidden paywalls, deck creation limits, or intrusive advertising. Complete freedom to learn.

modes.title: Study Modes
modes.description: Study flashcards however and whenever you want. You can speed through them in interactive turbo mode or type out the card values manually.

hero.title: Cards that know when you'll forget them
hero.description: Vexel schedules each card right before it slips your mind — and turns review into something you'd actually choose to do.

comparison.title: The comparison is clear
comparison.description: Vexel is an open-source Quizlet alternative without limits or intrusive advertising.

cta.title: Ready to start learning?
